achievements.title: Awakened Power

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Finish the April 9 rooftop story encounter and obtain Orpheus. Read the battle prompts before marking the full-moon task Done.

achievements.title: SEES the Day
achievements.description: Joined the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad.

tracking.prompt: Mark the April 18 Fool story introduction Done after joining S.E.E.S.

achievements.guidance: Finish the April 18 joining scene. Its Fool rank-1 task records joining S.E.E.S.; passing the date or answering the class question does not record that scene.

achievements.title: Back on Track

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Defeat Priestess during the May 9 monorail operation. Open the date below for countdown and summoned-Tiara guidance.

achievements.title: Empowered Protector

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Defeat both Emperor and Empress on June 8. Follow the operation’s affinity-switch guidance; Theurgy unlocks later on June 13.

achievements.title: Never Toy with Matters of the Heart
achievements.description: Defeated the Hierophant and the Lovers.

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Finish both the Hierophant and Lovers fights on July 7. The walkthrough includes the hotel barrier sequence and Charm recovery.

achievements.title: Armor Disarmed

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Finish the Chariot and Justice operation on August 6. Read the combined-form and revival instructions before marking the operation complete.

achievements.title: Dodging Lightning

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Defeat Hermit on September 5. Use the operation’s charging and resistance advice; an attempted fight is not a victory.

achievements.title: Twist of Fate

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Defeat Strength and Fortune on October 4. Reload’s roulette is automatic; follow the fight instructions and finish both enemies.

achievements.title: A Sense of Finality

tracking.prompt: Mark the story task Done after finishing the encounter.

achievements.guidance: Defeat Hanged Man on November 3 after the Strega encounter. Read the statues and summoned-enemy phases in that operation’s guidance.

achievements.title: The Great Seal

tracking.prompt: Record the December 31 story decision here, then confirm after sealing Nyx on The Promised Day.

items.label: Spare Ryoji — pursue the good ending
Kill Ryoji — end the story early

achievements.guidance: Spare Ryoji on December 31 and finish the January 31 finale, using Great Seal when prompted. Record the ending choice, then confirm after sealing Nyx.

achievements.title: From Shadows into Light

tracking.prompt: Record the December 31 story decision here, then confirm after watching the good ending on Graduation Day.

items.label: Spare Ryoji — pursue the good ending
Kill Ryoji — end the story early

achievements.guidance: Spare Ryoji on December 31, complete the finale, and watch the March 5 ending. The saved choice is shared with The Great Seal; confirm this achievement after the ending itself.

achievements.title: The Fool's Journey
achievements.description: Obtained 10 Major Arcana during Shuffle Time.
achievements.guidance: Record Major Arcana cards actually taken during Shuffle Time until the total reaches 10. A Tartarus visit alone does not record a card.

achievements.title: Distinguished Visitor
achievements.guidance: Finish Elizabeth’s outing/request chain and actually invite her to your room. This route records the room visit on November 6; merely accepting Request #81 does not finish it.

achievements.title: Top of the Class

tracking.prompt: Confirm when the May exam results show that you placed at the top of the class.

achievements.guidance: Check the May 25 exam results and confirm if you placed at the top. Correct exam answers and the planned Academics level are preparation; the result must be checked.

achievements.title: A Legacy of Friendships

tracking.prompt: Record the MAX milestone for all 22 Social Links, including the floor-driven Judgment task. Aeon MAX alone is not enough.

achievements.guidance: Max all 22 Social Links. Keep Bunkichi and Maiko rescued, complete the December 31 good-ending choice, and finish Judgment through 255F. This route’s final planned MAX is Aeon on January 29.

achievements.title: People Person

tracking.prompt: Record every Social Link introduction. The final Aeon introduction completes this only when all 22 starts are recorded.

achievements.guidance: Start all 22 Social Links, including the automatic story links. Aeon on January 8 is this route’s last introduction; review missing starts below instead of treating that one meeting as proof of every link.

achievements.title: That Special Someone

tracking.prompt: Confirm after choosing a romance branch in any eligible Social Link.

achievements.guidance: Choose a romance branch in an eligible Social Link and confirm once the relationship begins. Follow the romance answers in the relevant task; a platonic branch or rank-up alone does not prove romance.

achievements.title: Unbreakable Link

tracking.prompt: Any recorded Social Link MAX milestone qualifies; Devil is this route’s first planned MAX.

achievements.guidance: Reach rank 10 in any Social Link. This route’s first planned MAX is Devil on September 1, but another completed MAX milestone also qualifies.

achievements.title: A Newfound Strength
achievements.guidance: Watch the story progression through December 30. The route treats all required ultimate-Persona awakenings as complete after ending that day; optional Combat Characteristics and Theurgy uses are separate.

achievements.title: The Power of Choice
achievements.guidance: Count Personas actually acquired from Shuffle Time until the total reaches 10. Taking a Persona already in your stock does not count as a new acquisition.

achievements.title: There's No “I” in “Team”

tracking.prompt: Confirm after performing a Shift in battle.

achievements.guidance: Perform a Shift in battle after earning an extra turn. Confirm after passing the turn; opening the tutorial or reading combat guidance is not the action.

achievements.title: The Strength of Our Hearts

tracking.prompt: Check each teammate after using at least one of their Theurgies, including Fuuka’s support Theurgy. Use Shinjiro’s before October 4; this route’s final planned opportunity is October 1.

achievements.guidance: Use at least one Theurgy from each of the nine listed teammates, including Fuuka’s support Theurgy. You do not need every variant. Include Shinjiro before October 4; use the October 1 Tartarus visit for any missing uses.

achievements.title: Extracurricular Excellence

tracking.prompt: A completed rescue visit proves this. If you rescued someone outside the planned visit, confirm the achievement yourself; police reward collection is separate.

achievements.guidance: Find a missing person in Tartarus and escort them back. Complete all named rescues before marking a combined rescue visit Done. Claiming their police rewards is a later action.

achievements.title: Get a Load of Those Numbers!
achievements.description: Dealt over 999 damage in a single attack (All-Out Attacks excluded).

tracking.prompt: Confirm after dealing over 999 damage in one non-All-Out attack.

achievements.guidance: Deal at least 1,000 damage in one attack that is not an All-Out Attack. Confirm after seeing the damage result; having a powerful Theurgy available is not proof of that hit.

achievements.title: Shrouded Assassin
achievements.guidance: Start battles with a Chance Encounter by striking a Shadow from behind. Record successful advantages until the total reaches 50; ordinary encounters do not add to this count.

achievements.title: The Thrill of the Hunt

tracking.prompt: Confirm after defeating a rare golden enemy in Tartarus.

achievements.guidance: Catch and defeat a rare golden Shadow in Tartarus. A Rarity Fortune may help you find one, but spotting it or buying the fortune does not prove a kill.

achievements.title: Making the Dream Work
achievements.guidance: Perform 50 All-Out Attacks. Record attacks you actually execute after downing the enemy group, rather than counting battles or individual knockdowns.

achievements.title: Glimpse of the Depths
achievements.guidance: Enter and conquer 10 Monad Doors, completing the fights and taking the rewards. Keep the count separate from scheduled gatekeeper floors and fixed Monad Passage progression.

achievements.title: Briefcase Burglar
achievements.guidance: Open 50 treasure chests. Add to the counter only when you open a chest; exploring a floor or finding a locked chest does not count.

achievements.title: Shattered Plumes
achievements.description: Used a total of 50 Twilight Fragments.
achievements.guidance: Spend 50 Twilight Fragments in total. Record fragments consumed by locked chests or healing; collecting town fragments contributes to Eagle Eye instead.

achievements.title: The Horror of the Shade
achievements.description: Encountered a Dark Zone in Tartarus.

tracking.prompt: Confirm after encountering a random Dark Zone after the Tziah tutorial; the scripted tutorial Dark Zone does not count.

achievements.guidance: Encounter a random Dark Zone after the scripted Tziah introduction. The tutorial on the October 1 visit does not unlock this achievement, so confirm only after a later random encounter.

achievements.title: Reaper Reaped

tracking.prompt: The January 21 task includes the actual victory. Preparation or reading the January 31 advice does not count. You can confirm an earlier victory yourself.

achievements.guidance: Actually defeat the Reaper. The January 21 task includes the victory and Request #100 hand-in; January 31’s Armageddon note is advice. Confirm a victory outside the scheduled task yourself.

achievements.title: The First of Many

tracking.prompt: Confirm after performing a Dyad Fusion.

achievements.guidance: Use Dyad Fusion in the Velvet Room to fuse two Personas. Confirm after the fusion completes, rather than after viewing a recipe.

achievements.title: Fusion Artisan
achievements.description: Performed a fusion with three or more Personas.

tracking.prompt: Confirm after performing a fusion using three or more Personas.

achievements.guidance: Complete a Special Fusion using three or more Personas. Unlocking a fusion recipe or registering ingredients is preparation; confirm the completed fusion.

achievements.title: Birthday Present
achievements.description: Obtained an item from a Persona Conception.

tracking.prompt: Confirm after receiving an item from a Persona Conception.

achievements.guidance: Level a Persona with a heart/conception item until it gives you the item. Confirm when you receive it, not when the heart icon first appears.

achievements.title: Path to Salvation

tracking.prompt: Judgment MAX unlocks the fusion; confirm after actually fusing Messiah. January 31 is a route reminder, not the first possible fusion date.

achievements.guidance: Reach Judgment MAX by clearing the Adamah milestones through 255F, then fuse Orpheus and Thanatos into Messiah when the fusion’s level requirements are met. The January 31 note is a cleanup reminder; confirmation remains available without waiting for that date.

achievements.title: Tempting Fate
achievements.description: Triggered a skill change during fusion.

tracking.prompt: Confirm after a skill changes during fusion.

achievements.guidance: Accept a skill change when offered during fusion. Confirm after the change occurs; a normal fusion or learning a skill by leveling does not qualify.

achievements.title: Eat Your Veggies, Peas!
achievements.description: Harvested a crop that you grew with a teammate.

tracking.prompt: The July 18 Junpei gardening visit is preparation. Confirm after harvesting a crop that a teammate helped grow; planting or spending the evening together is not the harvest.

achievements.guidance: Grow a crop with a teammate at the dorm and later harvest that crop. The route’s July 18 Junpei gardening hangout prepares this, but the harvest needs its own confirmation.

achievements.title: The Grindset Mindset
achievements.description: Earned over 50,000 yen total from part-time jobs.

tracking.prompt: Enter your cumulative earnings from part-time jobs; the route expects this to cross the threshold by the December 29 Be Blue V shift.

achievements.guidance: Record cumulative wages from part-time jobs until earnings exceed ¥50,000. This route expects the goal by the December 29 Be Blue V shift. Current money, purchases and battle income are not wages; you can edit the total to correct it.

achievements.title: Specialist

tracking.prompt: Any one recorded rank-6 Social Stat milestone qualifies.

achievements.guidance: Reach rank 6 in Courage, Charm or Academics. The route first plans Courage MAX on June 19; any recorded rank-6 milestone qualifies.

achievements.title: Peak Performance
achievements.guidance: Reach rank 6 in all three Social Stats. Record Courage, Charm and Academics MAX separately; the last planned milestone is Academics on October 29.

achievements.title: Dorm Life
achievements.description: Spent an evening in the dorm with a teammate.

tracking.prompt: Any completed dorm hangout listed here qualifies. Social Link meetings and Linked Episodes are different activities.

achievements.guidance: Spend an evening in a listed dorm hangout with a teammate. Reading, cooking, gardening and the other explicit hangouts qualify; ordinary Social Link visits and Linked Episodes are tracked separately.

achievements.title: Gourmand
achievements.description: Ordered from a secret menu at the Iwatodai strip mall at night.

tracking.prompt: Any recorded nighttime Seafood Full Course visit qualifies. Confirm yourself if you used another valid secret menu.

achievements.guidance: Order a secret-menu meal at night in Iwatodai Strip Mall. This route’s nighttime Seafood Full Course visits qualify; verify the order rather than merely entering Wakatsu Kitchen.

achievements.title: Benevolent Purr-tector
achievements.description: Nursed a cat back to full health.
achievements.guidance: Finish all four scheduled cat feedings for Request #42, ending July 13. Buying Super Cat Food or completing only some feedings does not nurse the cat fully.

achievements.title: In High Demand
achievements.description: Accepted an invitation to hang out five times.
achievements.guidance: Accept five actual phone invitations to hang out. Follow the five recorded invitation tasks; ordinary Social Link visits do not substitute for an invitation.

achievements.title: Beyond the Darkness
achievements.description: Unlocked access to the remaining Major Arcana.
achievements.guidance: Finish the fixed 91F Monad Passage and collect its tarot reward. The route plans this on August 3; entering a random Monad Door or reaching 91F alone is not the reward.

achievements.title: Through Thick and Thin

tracking.prompt: Any teammate’s recorded unlock qualifies. Ordinary hangouts that have not yet unlocked the Characteristic do not prove it.

achievements.guidance: Complete enough dorm hangouts to unlock a teammate’s Combat Characteristic. Any listed unlock milestone qualifies; an earlier ordinary hangout does not prove the unlock.

achievements.title: Eagle Eye
achievements.description: Acquired every Twilight Fragment in town.
achievements.guidance: Collect every fixed Twilight Fragment in town, including the dorm and later-accessible remaining locations. Complete all three collection tasks; finding random fragments in Tartarus is separate.
